title: What does Sellercloud cost in 2026?
summary: Nov 23, 2026 • Sellercloud's published plans start at $1,349 a month. Here is what each plan costs, what the price depends on, and what to ask before you renew.
body_markdown:
If your Sellercloud contract is up for renewal, the first question is whether your bill is normal. Sellercloud now publishes starting prices on its own pricing page, so you can check.


## Sellercloud's published plans


These are quoted from[sellercloud.com/pricing](https://sellercloud.com/pricing/) , read on 8 November 2026:


- **Essentials:** "Starting at $1,349 / month"
- **Growth:** "Starting at $1,998 / month"
- **Enterprise:** "Custom pricing"


Sellercloud also says that "plans are typically offered through an annual subscription."


## What moves the price


These are starting prices, not the full bill. Sellercloud's pricing page says final pricing depends on your order volume and fulfilment mix, among other things. Its FAQ says per-order fees fall as volume rises, but it does not publish those fees. To know your real cost, ask for the per-order rate at your volume in writing.


## Why you may see lower numbers elsewhere


Review sites list different figures. ITQlick, for example, lists Sellercloud at $500 a month. That does not match Sellercloud's own page, so treat third-party numbers as out of date and go by Sellercloud's published prices.


## Questions to ask before you renew


- What will I pay per order at my current volume, and at double it?
- Is the annual term required, and what happens if my volume drops?
- Are there extra fees for added channels, users or integrations?
- How long will onboarding take, and what support is included?


## Comparing your options


If you are weighing a switch, see how Sellercloud and Zentail compare on listings, catalog data and marketplace launches:[Zentail vs. Sellercloud](https://www.zentail.com/compare/sellercloud) .
